Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the batching options. Before we proceed to a POC, Procurement asked me to clarify a few things around our AP policies so we can recommend the right commercial path:

- Our AP policy: vendor agreements > $50k require a PO and 30-day net terms; purchases under $5k can be charged on a corporate card.
- Marketplace purchases (AWS Marketplace / cloud marketplace) are preferred for some teams because ordering is simpler, but vendor must be listed and verified.
- We need SOC 2 or equivalent security evidence and an onboarding checklist for vendor setup.

Can Redwood accept an initial POC billed to a corporate card (we expect costs < $5k) and then switch to PO for production? Also, do you have a marketplace listing or timeline for one?

If helpful, I can loop in our procurement lead (procurement@greenstride.com) with any docs you send.
